# Muiz Hot Chicken – Flagship Outlet Website

## Site Overview
- **Official Website:** Restoran Pak Haji Ali & Muiz Hot Chicken
- **Flagship Outlet:** Subang Jaya (USJ 8), Selangor, Malaysia
- **Concept:** Hybrid dining – crispy Muiz Hot Chicken + traditional Malaysian cuisine (Nasi Kandar, Nasi Ayam, Ayam Penyet, Tomyam)
- **Certifications:** JAKIM Halal & MeSTI
- **Operating Hours:** 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM Daily
- **Contact:** +6017-908 1447
